title: Summer Basil Pesto Pasta
description: A simple and delicious pasta dish made with fresh basil and a hint of breeze.

ingredients.name: Fresh basil
ingredients.notes: use the breeze to keep fresh

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the linguine noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
In a blender or food processor, combine basil, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the olive oil until well combined.
Transfer the pesto sauce to a bowl and stir in Parmesan cheese.
Drain the cooked noodles and add to the pesto sauce.
Toss to combine and season with black pepper to taste.
